de bzhin du g.yon pa'i phrag pa dang dpung pa'i tshigs kyi rtsa sum cu la rim pa bzhin da di dr-i du ng+l-I daM/ de bzhin du g+ha dang ga dang kha dang ka la rim pa bzhin sbyar bas sum cu'o/ / de bzhin du g.yas kyi dpung pa dang nye ba'i dpung pa'i tshigs la tsa sde [26] brtsegs pa ring po/ g.yon gyi dpung pa dang nye ba'i dpung pa'i tshigs la tsa sde rkyang pa thung ngu / g.yas kyi nye ba'i dpung pa dang lag pa'i tshigs la Ta sde brtsegs pa ring po/ g.yon pa'i nye ba'i dpung pa dang lag pa'i tshigs la Ta sde rkyang pa thung ngu / g.yas kyi dpyi dang brla'i tshigs la pa sde brtsegs pa ring po/ g.yon gyi dpyi dang brla'i tshigs la pa sde rkyang pa thung ngu / g.yas kyi brla dang byin pa'i tshigs la ta sde brtsegs pa ring po/ g.yon gyi brla dang byin pa'i tshigs la ta sde rkyang pa thung ngu / g.yas kyi byin pa dang rkang pa'i tshigs la sa sde brtsegs pa ring po/ g.yon gyi byin pa dang rkang pa'i tshigs la sa sde rkyang pa thung ngu'o/ /

Likewise, on the channels of the left shoulder joint are the single syllables ṅa, ṅi, ṅṛi, ṅu, ṅḷi, and ṅaṃ plus similar groups made up of the consonants gha, ga, kha, and ka, to make thirty in total. On the channels of the right elbow joint are the long-vowel stacked consonants of the ca group. On those of the left elbow joint are the short-vowel single syllables of the ca group. On the channels of the right wrist joint are the long stacked ṭa group syllables. On the channels of the left wrist joint are short single syllables of the ṭa group. On the channels of the right hip joint are the long stacked syllables of the pa group. On those of the left hip joint are the short single pa group syllables. On the channels of the right knee joint are the long stacked syllables of the ta group. On those of the left knee joint are the short single ta group syllables. On the channels of the right ankle joint are the long stacked syllables of the sa group, while on those of the left ankle joint are the short single sa group syllables.

d.div: [26] skabs du mar tsa sde la ca sde zhes bris lugs yod 'on kyang tshang ma gcig mthun du tsa sde zhes bcos yod/

f.d: de ltar na nang le'i re bdun pa rtsa 'grel gyi skabs 'di ni dus 'chi'i rtsa gcod pa'i skabs dang / khyim rnams zla ba'i mar ngo sngon 'gro dang sbyor ba'i skabs yin pas sa ga zla ba'i tshes rnams tsa sde'i gsal byed lugs bzlog dbyangs thung ngu lnga rjes su nga ro dang bcas pa'i drug lugs 'byung du srog tu zhugs pa dang sbyar ba dang / nag pa zla ba'i tshes rnams tsa sde'i gsal byed lugs 'byung dbyangs ring po lnga tshig drag dang bcas pa'i drug lugs bzlog tu srog tu zhugs pa dang sbyor ba sogs rigs pa yin no/ /

The commentary from the sixty-seventh verse of the Inner chapter is in the context of channel dissolution at the end of a completed life[44] and also in the context of the houses being applied to a waning-led month. Therefore the lunar deities of Vaiśākha are assigned to the ca group of consonants in reverse order and with short vowels and anusvāra embedded in forward order. /244/ The lunar deities of Caitra are assigned to the ca group of consonants in forward order with long vowels and visarga embedded in reverse order.

d.div: [44] “Completed” means not dying before one’s time, which here is one hundred years.

f.d: dus 'chi'i las kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa gcod pa'i thog ma g.yas pa'i phrag pa dang dpung pa'i tshigs kyi rtsa dang / gsal byed rnams kyi nang nas sde pa'i dang po ka sde dang / de yang 'chi ba'i gnas skabs sdud rim yin pas khams sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams kyi gsal byed kyi yi ge ka sde lugs 'byung dang / yang khams de rnams kyi dbyangs kyi yi ge rim pa bzhin lI yig sogs lnga lugs bzlog dang / tha ma ye shes kyi yi ge rnam gcad rnams srog tu zhugs pa dang / de yang khyim rnams mar ngo sngon 'gro'i tshes zla dang sbyar ba na rtsa rnams dang khyim zhag rnams dang tshes zla rnams kyi sa bon gyi yi ge gong du bshad pa ltar 'gyur na'ang / tshes lha spro ba'i skabs 'dir ni de dag dang mi 'dra'o/ /

The first channels of the action-faculty cakras to die at the end of a completed life are those of the right shoulder joint. Of the consonant groups the first is the ka group. Death is a withdrawal process, and so the consonants of the elements of earth, water, fire, air, and space are of the ka group in forward order, while the five vowels of those elements beginning with ḷī are in reverse order. Finally the visarga of the gnosis element is embedded. When the houses are assigned to a waning-led lunar month, the syllables of the channels, house days, and lunar months are as explained above. However the explanation of the lunar-day deity emanation taught in this section of the text is different.

'o na mi 'dra ba'i tshul ji ltar yin snyam na/ tshes lha spro ba'i skabs 'dir ni thog mar nag zla'i tshes lha rnams spro ba dang / de yang khams snyoms pa'i gnas skabs kyi thog mar nam mkha' rlung me chu sa rnams skye ba'i rim pas spro ba dang khyim rnams kyang yar ngo sngon 'gro'i tshes zla rnams dang sbyor bas gong du bshad pa dang tshul mi 'dra'o/ /

So what is the difference? The lunar-day deity emanation as taught in this part of the text begins with the emanation of the lunar-day deities of Caitra. They emanate in the creation order of the elements, which are in a state of inactive absorption, as space, air, fire, water, and earth, respectively. The houses also are assigned to a waxing-led month. Those are the differences.

de yang lug khyim gyi khyim zhag sum cu dang / yar ngo sngon 'gro'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes zhag sum cu dang / g.yon pa'i dpung pa dang nye ba'i dpung pa'i tshigs kyi rtsa sum cu dang / lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung gi tshigs bar pa nas mthe bo'i tshigs bar pa'i bar gyi tshigs rnams re re la rtsa drug drug ste sum cu ste de rnams rlung gi khams pa yin pas sa bon gyi yi ge tsa sde dang / de yang thog ma khams rnams skye ba'i rim pa nas brtsams pa yin pas tsa sde rnams lugs bzlog dang thabs shes gnyis kyi nang gi thabs kyi phyogs yin pas a i r-i u l-i aM gi bar thung ngu rnams lugs mthun du srog tu zhugs pa rnams su sbyar bar bya ba yin no/ /

The thirty days of the house of Aries, the thirty lunar days of a waxing-led Caitra, the thirty channels of the left upper and lower arm joint, and the thirty channels in five groups of six from the middle joint of the left little finger to the middle joint of the left thumb are those of the air element. Its syllable group, therefore, is ca. Because this process begins with the creation of the elements, the ca group is in reverse order. Between method and wisdom it belongs to the method sphere, and its vowels — a, i, ṛi, u, ḷī, aṃ — therefore are short and in forward order.

de bzhin du khyim zhag glang khyim gyi khyim zhag sum cu/ tshes zhag yar ngo sngon 'gro'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes zhag sum cu/ las kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa g.yas pa'i nye ba'i dpung pa dang lag mgo'i tshigs kyi rtsa sum cu/ bya ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsa lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bo nas mthe chung gi bar gyi tshigs gong ma rnams re re la rtsa drug drug ste sum cu'o/ /

Similarly the thirty house days of Taurus, the thirty lunar days of the waxing-led Vaiśākha, the thirty channels of the action-faculty cakra of the joint between right lower arm and hand, the thirty activity-wheel channels in five groups of six on the upper joints of the right hand running from the thumb to the little finger, are also of the air element and are assigned to the ca syllable group. /245/

de rnams kyang rlung gi khams pa yin pas sa bon gyi yi ge tsa sde/ g.yas shes rab kyi cha'i khams rnams sdud rim yin pas gsal byed tsa sde rnams lugs 'byung dang / dbyangs ring po lnga tsheg drag dang bcas pa lugs bzlog tu srog tu zhugs pa rnams su sbyar bar bya ba yin no/ /

The elements on the right of the body, of the wisdom sphere, begin from the withdrawal process, and the ca consonant group, therefore, is in forward order. The vowels, plus visarga, are long and in reverse order.

dpe de ji lta ba bzhin du khyim zhag dang / yar ngo sngon 'gro'i zla ba rnams kyi tshes zhag dang / las kyi 'khor lo dang bya ba'i 'khor lo'i tshigs rnams kyi rtsa dang / sa bon gyi gsal byed sde tshan g.yon la sbyar ba rnams lugs bzlog_g.yas la sbyar ba rnams lugs mthun/ gsal byed lugs bzlog tu sbyar ba rnams la dbyangs thung ngu rnams lugs mthun/ gsal byed lugs mthun du sbyar ba rnams la dbyangs ring po rnams lugs bzlog tu srog tu 'jug pa rnams su shes par bya zhing / khyim rnams kyi lug khyim dang por byas pa dang / tshes zla rnams kyi nag zla dang por byas pa dang / gsal byed rnams kyi tsa sde dang por byas pa dang / khams rnams kyi skye rim dang por byas pa dang / dbyangs rnams kyi thung ngu dang por byas pa dang / las kyi 'khor lo'i tshigs kyi rtsa rnams kyi g.yon pa'i dpung pa dang nye ba'i dpung pa'i tshigs kyi rtsa rnams dang por byas pa dang / bya ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsa rnams kyi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe chung nas mthe bo'i bar gyi tshigs bar pa rnams kyi rtsa rnams dang por byas pa ste/ de nas glang khyim sogs khyim rnams dang / sa ga zla ba sogs tshes zla rnams dang / tshes zla dang khyim zla gnyis gnyis la tsa sde nas ka sde'i bar gyi sde pa re re dang / de yang mi mnyam pa'i khyim dang zla ba la gsal byed lugs bzlog dbyangs thung ngu lugs 'byung du srog tu zhugs pa dang / mnyam pa'i khyim dang tshes zla la gsal byed lugs mthun dbyangs ring po lugs bzlog tu srog tu zhugs pa sbyor bar byed pa go sla la/ tshigs kyi rtsa rnams kyi rim pa ni g.yon pa'i dpung pa dang nye ba'i dpung pa'i tshigs kyi rjes su g.yas pa'i nye ba'i dpung pa dang lag pa'i tshigs/ de nas g.yon pa'i nye ba'i dpung pa dang lag pa'i tshigs/ de nas g.yas pa'i dpyi dang brla'i tshigs/ de nas g.yon pa'i dpyi dang brla'i tshigs/ de nas g.yas pa'i brla dang byin pa'i tshigs/ de nas g.yon pa'i brla dang byin pa'i tshigs/ de nas g.yas pa'i byin pa dang rkang mgo'i tshigs/ de nas g.yon pa'i byin pa dang rkang mgo'i tshigs/ de nas g.yas pa'i phrag pa dang dpung pa'i tshigs/ de nas g.yon pa'i phrag pa dang dpung pa'i tshigs te rim pa de ltar sbyar bar bya ba yin no/ /

From this example, therefore, one can know that the zodiacal days, the lunar days of a waxing-led month, the channels of action-faculty cakra and activity-cakra joints, and the consonant groups assigned to the left are all in reverse order, whereas those assigned to the right are in forward order. On the consonants in reverse order, the vowels are short, while the consonants in forward order have long vowels. Of the houses in this section, Aries is first. Of the lunar months Caitra is first. Of the consonant groups the ca group is first. Of the withdrawal and creation of the elements, creation comes first. Of the vowels the short vowels come first. Of the channels of the action faculty cakras situated at the joints, the channels of the left upper and lower arm joint are first. Of the activity-cakra channels, those spread across the middle joints of the left hand from the little finger to the thumb are first. After this group comes Taurus and the other houses and Vaiśākha and the other lunar months. The lunar months and zodiacal months are assigned to the consonant groups from ca to ka. On the odd numbered houses and months, the consonants are in reverse order with short vowels embedded in forward order. On the even numbered houses and months, the consonants are in forward order with long vowels embedded in reverse order. This is not difficult to understand. Concerning the sequence of the channels for the various correlations, those of the left elbow joint are followed by those of the right wrist joint. Then come those of the left wrist joint, followed by the right hip joint, the left hip joint, the right knee joint, the left knee joint, /246/ the right ankle joint, the left ankle joint, the right shoulder joint, the left shoulder joint, and the right elbow joint.

de ltar sbyor ba na g.yon gyi tshigs kyi rtsa rnams la phrag pa dang dpung pa'i tshigs kyi rtsa nas byin pa dang rkang pa'i tshigs kyi rtsa'i bar la rim pa bzhin khyim bum pa lug 'khrig pa seng+ge srang gzhu ste mi mnyam pa'i khyim dang / tshes zla mchu nag pa snon gro bzhin tha skar mgo ste mnyam pa'i zla ba dang / sa bon gsal byed ka sde nas sa sde'i bar rim pa bzhin dang / sde tshan rnams lugs bzlog la dbyangs thung ngu rnams lugs mthun du srog tu zhugs pa byed pa dang / g.yas kyi tshigs kyi rtsa rnams la dpung pa dang nye ba'i dpung pa'i rtsa nas byin pa dang rkang pa'i tshigs kyi rtsa'i bar dang / de'i rjes su phrag pa dang dpung pa'i tshigs kyi rtsa rnams la rim pa bzhin khyim nya glang karka Ta bu mo sdig pa chu srin ste mnyam pa'i khyim rnams dang / tshes zla dbo sa ga chu stod khrums smin drug rgyal gyi zla ba ste mnyam pa'i zla ba dang / sa bon gsal byed ka sde nas sa sde'i bar rim pa bzhin dang / sde tshan rnams lugs mthun la dbyangs ring po rnams lugs bzlog tu srog tu zhugs pa dang / tshes lha rnams spro ba'i tshe yang thog mar nag zla'i tshes lha rnams spro ba nas mthar dbo zla'i tshes lha rnams spro ba yin zhing / mi mnyam pa'i zla ba'i tshes lha rnams rim pa bzhin gsal byed kyi sde tshan gang dang gang yin pa'i sde tshan de lugs bzlog la dbyangs thung ngu lugs mthun du srog tu zhugs pa las spro ba dang / mnyam pa'i zla ba'i tshes lha rnams rim pa gzhin gsal byed sde tshan gang dang gang yin pa de lugs mthun la dbyangs ring po lugs bzlog tu srog tu zhugs pa las spro ba yin no/ /

When correlation is made in this order, the channels on the left, starting from those of the left shoulder joint to those of the left ankle joint, are assigned the odd-numbered houses of Aquarius, Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, and Sagittarius, respectively, as well the odd-numbered lunar months of Maghā, Caitra, Jyeṣṭha, Śrāvana, Aśvinī, and Mṛigaśira. The consonant groups on the left run from ka to sa, are in reverse order with short vowels embedded in forward order. The joint channels on the right run from those of the right elbow joint, down to those of the ankle and up to the channels of the right shoulder joint. They host the even-numbered houses of Pisces, Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, and Capricorn, as well as the even-numbered lunar months of Phālguna, Vaiśākha, Aṣaḍha, Bhādra, Kārttikā, and Puṣya. The consonant groups run from ka to sa, are in forward order with long vowels embedded in reverse order. Also, when the lunar-day deities emanate, the order of emanation is from Caitra to Phālguna. The lunar-day deities of the odd-numbered months emanate from their respective consonant groups, which are in reverse order with short vowels embedded in forward order. Those of the even-numbered months emanate from their respective consonant groups, which are in forward order with long vowels embedded in reverse order.

de rnams kyi rgyu mtshan ni/ g.yon gyi rtsa rkyang ma khu ba dang zla ba'i chos yin pa bzhin du g.yon gyi las kyi 'khor lo dang bya ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsa rnams dang / bum khyim sogs mi mnyam pa'i khyim rnams dang / nag zla sogs mnyam pa'i zla ba rnams dang / nag zla'i tshes lha sogs mi mnyam pa'i zla ba'i tshes lha rnams khu ba dang zla ba'i chos dang / thabs shes gnyis kyi thabs kyi phyogs yin pas rang rang gi sa bon gyi gsal byed kyi sde tshan rnams lugs bzlog dang / dbyangs rnams thung du lugs mthun du srog tu zhugs par byed pa yin no/ /

The reasons for the above are as follows. The left channel is the channel of seminal fluid and of the moon. Similarly the channels of the action-faculty cakras and activity cakras on the left, the odd-numbered houses, the odd-numbered months, and the lunar-day deities of the odd-numbered months are all moon and seminal fluid phenomena. Between method and wisdom they belong to the realm of method, and so their individual seed syllable consonant groups are in reverse order with short vowels embedded in forward order. /247/

de ltar byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / de ltar du bshad pa'i rtsa nas tshes zla'i bar gyi khams rnams skye ba'i rim pa nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i rim pas 'char ba yin la/ de yang 'byung ba che ba'i dbang du byas na ka sde nas mkha'/ tsa sde rlung / Ta sde me/ pa sde chu/ ta sde sa/ sa sde ye shes kyi khams pa yin zhing / 'byung ba chung ba'i dbang du byas na nga yig nam mkha'i nam mkha'/ g+ha yig nam mkha'i rlung / ga yig nam mkha'i me/ kha yig nam mkha'i chu/ ka yig nam mkha'i sa dang / de bzhin du nya yig rlung gi nam mkha' yin pa nas tsa yig rlung gi sa yin pa'i bar dang / Na yig me'i nam mkha' yin pa nas/ Ta yig me'i sa yin pa'i bar dang / ma yig chu'i nam mkha' yin pa nas/ pa yig chu'i sa yin pa'i bar dang / na yig sa'i nam mkha' yin pa nas/ ta yig sa'i sa yin pa'i bar dang / Sh+ka yig ye shes kyi nam mkha' yin pa nas/ sa yig ye shes kyi sa'i khams yin pa'i bar du yin la/

Also the elements correlating with these channels and other phenomena through to the lunar-day deities are in their creation order of space, air, fire, water, and earth. In terms of the major elements, ka is space, ca is air, ṭa is fire, pa is water, ta is earth, and sa is gnosis. In terms of the minor elements, ṅa is the space of space, gha is the air of space, ga is the fire of space, kha is the water of space, and ka is the earth of space. Likewise the sequence runs from ña as the space of air to ca as the earth of air. Ṇa is the space of fire, and so on, to ṭa being the earth of fire. Ma is the space of water, continuing on to pa as the earth of water. Na is the space of earth, continuing on to ta as the earth of earth. Kṣa is the space of gnosis, continuing in sequence to sa as the earth of gnosis.

de yang 'byung ba che ba'i dbang du byas na/ rtsa las kyi 'khor lo'i g.yon pa'i dpung pa dang nye ba'i dpung pa'i tshigs kyi rtsa dang / g.yas pa'i nye ba'i dpung pa dang lag pa'i tshigs kyi rtsa dang / bya ba'i 'khor lo g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams kyi tshigs bar pa rnams kyi rtsa dang / g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams kyi tshigs gong ma rnams kyi rtsa dang / khyim lug glang gnyis dang / tshes zla nag pa dang sa ga gnyis dang / tshes lha srin po 'khor bcas dang rlung lha 'khor bcas gnyis rnams rlung khams pa dang / de bzhin du gong du bshad pa'i rim pa ji lta ba bzhin gyi rtsa khyim tshes zla tshes lha rnams nyis tshan re khams lhag ma me chu sa ye shes nam mkha'i khams rnams dang rim pa bzhin sbyar bar bya'o/ /

In terms of the major elements, the channels of the action-faculty cakras on the left elbow joint and those on the right wrist joint, the channels of the activity cakras on the middle joints of the left fingers and those on the upper joints of the right fingers, the two houses Aries and Taurus, the lunar months Caitra and Vaiśākha, and the lunar deities Rakṣā plus entourage and Vāyu plus entourage, are all of the element air. Similarly each pairing of channels, houses, lunar months, and lunar deities, in the order explained above, correlate with the remaining elements of fire, water, earth, gnosis, and space.

'byung ba chung ba'i dbang du byas na thabs kyi phyogs rnams la 'byung ba chung ba rnams skye ba'i rim pas rang rang gi gsal byed kyi sde tshan rnams lugs bzlog gi tshul la dbyangs kyang nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ye shes kyi rim pas lugs mthun du srog tu 'jug pa yin no/ / de bzhin du g.yas kyi rtsa rnams dang sbyang ba'i khyim dang tshes zla dang tshes lha rnams kyang rdul dang nyi ma'i chos yin pas na shes rab kyi phyogs yin pas sa bon gyi tshul dang khams rnams sdud rim gyi 'byung ba che ba'i sdud rim dang chung ba'i sdud rim dang dbyangs kyi sdud rim dang / shes rab thabs las nyis 'gyur yin pas dbyangs rnams ring por byed pa sogs gong du bshad pa rnams la dpags nas shes par bya'o/ /

In terms of the minor elements, those of the sphere of method are in the minor-element creation order. Therefore the consonant groups are in reverse order, while the vowels are in the order of space, air, fire, water, earth, and gnosis, and are therefore embedded in forward order. The houses, lunar months, and lunar-day deities applied to the channels on the right are the phenomena of blood and sun, and therefore are of the sphere of wisdom. /248/ The arrangement of the seed syllables, the withdrawal order of the major and minor elements, and the length of the vowels, which are long because wisdom is twice that of method, can all be known by referring to the above explanations.

'on kyang nang le dang 'jig rten khams ler shes rab thabs las nyis 'gyur yin pas gsal byed rnams kyang nyis brtsegs su bshad kyang / tshes lha'i skabs 'dir ni tshes lha rnams zla ba'i dkar cha skye ba dang nag cha 'phel ba'i cha nas bzhag pas tshes zhag rnams khyim zhag la ltos nas thabs kyi phyogs dang zla ba'i chos yin pas gsal byed la dbyangs ring po srog tu zhugs pa'i tshe yang nyis brtsegs mi mdzad par rkyang pa mdzad pa yin no/ /

In the Inner chapter and Realms chapter it is explained that because wisdom is twice the length of method, the consonants are also written as stacked doubles. However, here in this section, the generation of the lunar-day deities is assigned to the bright half of the month and their growth to the dark half. Therefore the lunar days compared to the house days are of the sphere of method and are phenomena of the moon. Therefore, even when the consonants are embedded with long vowels, they are not stacked but are single.
21. Analysis of the Colors of the Lunar-Day Deities

gzhan yang skabs 'dir tshes lha rnams kyi kha dog la cung zad tsam dpyad par bya ste 'di la gnyis/ sgrub le'i skabs 'dir bshad tshod tsam dgod pa dang / de la lugs tha dad pa gnyis su gyur tshul lo/ /

At this point the colors of the lunar-day deities need to be examined. This has two outlines: 1. Its presentation in the Methods of Accomplishment chapter 2. How that presentation has produced two different explanations
dang po [sgrub le'i skabs 'dir bshad ]ni

d.i: Its presentation in the Methods of Accomplishment chapter

f.d:
sgrub le'i so gsum pa'i 'grel chen las/
de'i phyi rol nyi ma'i pad+ma la zhes pa ni de'i phyi rol du sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi pad+ma bcu gnyis po rnams la shar gyi sgo'i g.yas kyi cha la sogs par ra ba'i rtsig pa la nam mkha'i snying po la sogs pa bzhin du bden bral la sogs pa rnams grangs bzhin du gsungs te/[27] zhes mtshams sbyar nas ra ba'i rtsig pa la yod tshul 'chad pa ni de'i 'phro nyid las/
lha min zhes pa bden bral te shar gyi sgo'i g.yas su'o/ /g.yo ba zhes pa rlung ste mer ro/ /zhes pa nas/ shar gyi sgo'i g.yon du khyab 'jug ste thams cad phyag bzhi pa'o/[28] / zhes pa'i bar gyis tshes lha rnams dgod pa shin tu gsal bar bstan la/

The Great Commentary on the thirty-third verse of the Methods of Accomplishment chapter says:
“Outside of that, the sun lotuses,” means that outside of that are the twelve lotuses of the body mandala. To the right of the eastern gate and so forth on the walls of the fence, like Khagarbha and the others, Nairtya and so on are numbered.[45] This establishes the directions and how the deities are placed on the walls of the fence. The text continues:
“Asura” means Nairtya, placed to the right of the eastern gate.[46] “Cala” refers to Vāyu, who is in the southeast. Yama is to the left of the southern gate. On the right is Agni. In the southwest is Ṣaṇmukha. To the left of the western gate is Yakṣa and to the right is Śakra.[47] In the northwest is Brahmā. To the left of the northern gate is Rudra, to the right Samudra. In the northeast is Gaṇapati. To the left of the eastern gate is Viṣṇu. All have four hands.[48] This passage teaches very clearly the positions of the lunar-day deities.

[46] Here and in the other mandala placements, right and left mean clockwise and counterclockwise, respectively, or right and left from within the mandala facing out.
[47] Also called Indra.
[48] Toh 845 Kangyur, rgyud, śrī, 213a2.

f.d:
yang de'i 'phro nyid kyi so bzhi pa'i 'grel chen las/
bcu gnyis po 'di rnams kyi g.yas kyi phyag gnyis la rim pa bzhin mtshan ma rnams su 'gyur te bden bral gyi dang po na ral gri dang gnyis pa na gri gug go[29] / zhes pa nas/
khyab 'jug gi dang po na 'khor lo dang gnyis pa na dbyug to'o/ / zhes pa'i bar phyag g.yas rnams kyi phyag mtshan dang /

The text continues with commentary on the thirty-fourth verse:
In the two right hands of each of these twelve are implements. In the first of Nairtya, a sword and a curved knife.[49] And so on until:
In the first of Viṣṇu a wheel, and in the second a club. /249/ Up to this point the passage is teaching the implements in the right hands.

d.div: [29] sde dge_845_bka'/ rgyud/ shrI_'grel chen dri med 'od/ 213_na4
[49] Toh 845 Kangyur, rgyud, śrī, 213a4.

f.d:
yang de'i 'phro nyid las/
de nas g.yon du bden bral gyi phyag dang po na phub dang gnyis pa na thod pa'o/ / zhes pa nas/
nor lha'i bu'i dang po na pad+ma dang gnyis pa na skye ba lnga pa'i dung ste thams cad kyi phyag g.yon pa gnyis la rim pa bzhin du mtshan ma rnams so/[30] / zhes pa'i bar gyis phyag g.yon pa rnams kyi phyag mtshan bstan cing /

The text continues:
Then on the left, in the first hand of Nairtya a shield, and in the second a skull. And so on until:
In the first of Vāsudeva[50] a lotus, and in the second a conch of five lives. These are, in order, the implements held in the two left hands.[51] This passage teaches the symbols held in the left hands.

d.div: [30] sde dge_845_bka'/ rgyud/ shrI_'grel chen dri med 'od/ 213_na7
[50] Viṣṇu.
[51] Toh 845 Kangyur, rgyud, śrī, 213a7.

f.d:
yang de nyid las/
de ltar nag pa'i zla ba'i tshes rnams bden bral gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la'o/ / zhes pa nas/
dbo'i zla ba'i tshes rnams gshin rje la'o/[31] / zhes pa'i bar gyis zla ba gang dang gang gi tshes kyi lha rnams lha chen bcu gnyis po de dang de'i 'khor yin par bstan cing /

In the same section, the text states:
The lunar days of Caitra are on the petals of the Nairtya lotus. And so on until:
The lunar days of Phālguna are on Yama.[52] This passage explains which lunar-day deities of which month are the entourage of which of the twelve great gods.

d.div: [31] sde dge_845_bka'/ rgyud/ shrI_'grel chen dri med 'od/ 213_ba5
[52] Toh 845 Kangyur, rgyud, śrī, 213b5.

f.d:
de'i 'phro nyid las/
lha mo rnams kyi kha dog dang mtshon cha dang dbyibs ni de bzhin no/[32] / zhes 'khor gyi lha mo rnams kyi sku mdog sogs rang rang gi gtso bo dang 'dra bar gsungs so/ /

The text continues:
The colors, implements, and forms of the goddesses are similar.[53] The colors and so forth of the female deity entourage[54] are those of the central deity.

d.div: [32] sde dge_845_bka'/ rgyud/ shrI_'grel chen dri med 'od/ 213_ba7
[53] Toh 845 Kangyur, rgyud, śrī, 213b7.
[54] The entourage lunar-day deities are all female.

f.d:
yang sgrub le'i gya bzhi pa'i 'grel chen las/
da ni sku'i dkyil 'khor la brgya byin la sogs pa rnams kyi sa bon gsungs te taM ni brgya byin dangzhes pa nas/
de ltar lo'i tshes kyi lha rnams kyi sa bon gyi nges pa'o/[33] / zhes pa'i bar gyis tshes lha sum brgya drug cu'i grangs dang / de rnams gang las bskyed pa'i sa bon dang / tshes lha so so'i ming dang / pad+ma'i 'dab ma gang dang gang la tshes kyi lha mo gang dgod pa dang / sa bon gang dang gang las bskyed pa'i lha rnams zla ba gang dang sbyor ba sogs shin tu gsal bar bstan to/ /

On the eighty-fourth verse of the Condensed Tantra, the Great Commentary says:
This teaches the seed syllables of Śakra and the others of the body mandala. The syllable tam is Śakra. And so on until:
These are the seed syllables of the lunar-day deities.[55] This passage numbers the lunar-day deities as 360, gives the seed syllables from which they emanate, the names of each of the deities, which lunar-day goddess sits on which petal of the lotus, and how these deities emanating from their individual syllables correlate with particular months.

d.div: [33] sde dge_845_bka'/ rgyud/ shrI_'grel chen dri med 'od/ 225_na4
[55] Toh 845 Kangyur, rgyud, śrī, 225a4.

f.d: gnyis pa de la lugs tha dad pa gnyis su gyur tshul ni/

d.i: How that presentation has produced two different explanations

f.d: a b+ha yas sku dkyil la bkod pa'i tshes lha shar phyogs dang me mtshams su bkod pa thams cad nag po dang / lho phyogs dang bden bral du bkod pa thams cad dmar po dang / byang phyogs dang dbang ldan du bkod pa thams cad dkar po dang / nub phyogs dang rlung du bkod pa thams cad ser por mdzad de/ byang sgo'i g.yon du bkod pa'i mgo'i tshes lha drag po 'khor dang bcas pa dkar po dang / nub sgo'i g.yon du bkod pa'i rgyal gyi tshes lha nor sbyin 'khor bcas ser po dang / shar sgo'i g.yon du bkod pa'i mchu'i tshes lha khyab 'jug 'khor bcas nag po dang / lho sgo'i g.yon du bkod pa'i dbo'i tshes lha gshin rje 'khor bcas dmar por mdzad pa la/

Abhayākaragupta has the lunar-day deities of the east and southeast[56] as black, those of the south and southwest red, those of the north and northeast white, and those of the west and northwest as yellow. Specifically he says that Rudra and entourage, who are the lunar-day deities of Mṛigaśira to the left of the northern door, are white. Kubera[57] and entourage, the lunar-day deities of Puṣya to the left of the western gate, are yellow. Viṣṇu and entourage, the lunar-day deities of Maghā sitting to the left of the eastern gate, are black. /250/ Yama and entourage, the lunar-day deities of Phālguna to the left of the southern gate, are red.

d.div: [56] The ninety deities of ENE, ESE, and SE.
[57] nor sbyin. Also called gnod sbyin (Yakṣa).

f.d: rong pa'i dus zhabs pa chen po sher seng ba la sogs pa mang dag na re/ lha lug khyu tsam gyi sku mdog nor zhes dgag pa mdzad do/ / de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mgo rgyal gyi tshes lha nga brgyad ni ye shes kyi khams pa sa bon sa sde las bskyed pa sku mdog sngon po dang / mchu dang dbo'i tshes lha nga brgyad ni nam mkha'i khams pa sa bon ka sde las bskyed pa sku mdog ljang gu yin no zhes gsung zhing / de'i sgrub byed la lung dang rigs pa gnyis 'god par byed do/ /

According to the tradition of Sherap Sengé, the great Kālacakrapāda of Rong,[58] and others, these groupings of deity colors are wrong. They refute the above presentation because in their words, the fifty-eight lunar-day deities[59] of Mṛigaśira and Puṣya are of the gnosis element, are created from the sa consonant group, and are blue in color. The fifty-eight lunar-day deities of Maghā and Phālguna are of the space element, develop from the ka consonant group, and are green. This assertion they back up with scripture and logic.

d.div: [58] Rongpa Sherap Sengé, thirteenth-century master in the Ra tradition.
[59] Two lotuses of deities minus the consort of the principal figure.

f.d:
de yang lung gi sgrub byed ni ye shes le'u'i tshigs bcad bcu bdun pa'i 'grel chen las/
da ni mi bskyod pa'i rigs spro ba gsungs pa gtsug tor dag pa'i stong pa las ni zhes pa ste gtsug tor gyi 'khor lor dag pa'i rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dag pa'i nam mkha'i khams las mchog gi rdo rje 'dzin pa mi bskyod pa ye shes kyis rgyas btab pa kha dog ljang gu dang / de bzhin du rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang gtsug tor dang rdo rje hUM mdzad dang drag spyan ma dang khro mo'i rgyal mo dang phyag na rdo rje dang chos kyi khams kyi rdo rje ma dang khyab 'jug dang gshin rje dang klu rgyal ba ste 'di rnams steng gi zhal nas stong pa las spros pa yon tan mang po'i gnas te las thams cad kyi dngos grub ster ba rdo rje'i mtshan ma can mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa nam mkha'i kha dog las ljang gu'o/[34] / zhes khyab 'jug dang gshin rje gnyis 'byung ba che ba'i nam mkha'i khams pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sku mdog ljang gu nam mkha'i kha dog las ljang gu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis bstan/ yang de'i 'phro nyid las/
'dir gsang ba'i 'khor lor dag pa'i ye shes kyi phung po dang dag pa'i ye shes kyi khams las rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i mtshan ma can rnam par shes pas rgyas btab pa dang / de bzhin du ye shes kyi khams shes rab sngon mo dang gnod mdzes rgyal po dang rdo rje shugs dang shin tu sngon mo dang khro mo'i dbang phyug ma dang drag po dang 'dzaM b+ha la dang kun tu bzang po dang sgra rdo rje ma dang klu rnam par rgyal ba ste skye bo kun la [35] phan pa 'di rnams ni srog chags rnams kyi thar pa'i rgyur ni 'og gzhi la ye shes kyi chos las spros pa shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes las kha dog sngon po ste mi bskyod pa sngon po'i cha byad can gyi rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab pa ni las thams cad sgrub par byed pa'o/[36] / zhes drag po dang 'dzaM b+ha la ste nor sbyin gnyis sku mdog sngon por gsungs shing /

The scripture comes from the Great Commentary on the seventeenth verse of the Gnosis chapter:
Now the generation of the Akṣobhya class is taught. “From the emptiness of the pure crown” means that from the pure aggregate of consciousness and the pure element of space within the crown cakra arises the great Vajradhara Akṣobhya sealed by gnosis and green in color. Similarly Vajradhātvīśvarī, Uṣṇīṣa, Vajrahūḥkāra, Raudrākṣī, Khrodinī, Vajrapāṇi, Dharma dhātu vajrā, Viṣṇu, Yama, and the nāga Jaya, emanate from the upper face. They are of many qualities, granting siddhis of every activity, marked by the sign of the vajra, sealed by Akṣobhya, arising as green from the color of space.[60] Therefore because Viṣṇu and Yama are of the major element of space, their color is “the color of space,” or green. The passage continues:
From the purified aggregate of gnosis and the purified element of gnosis within the secret cakra arises a blue Vajrasattva marked by a three-pointed vajra sealed by consciousness. Similarly Prajñānīla, Sumbha, Vajravega, Atinīla, Khrodinī, Īśvarī, Rudra, Jambhala, Samantabhadra, Śabdavajrā, and the nāga Vijaya, all of the gnosis element, these benefactors, causes of the liberation of sentient beings, emanate from the phenomena of gnosis in the lower foundation, arising in the color blue from the dharmadhātu gnosis and sealed by Vajrasattva in the form of a blue Akṣobhya in order to accomplish every activity.[61] /251/ This says that Rudra and Jambhala, or Kubera, are blue in color.

[35] ma dper skye ba kun gsal/
[36] sde dge_845_bka'/ rgyud/ shrI_'grel chen dri med 'od/ 363_na4
